notes.title: "Time-Space Rebuild" topped the list of popular new release products.
notes.notes:
Dear Ravens,
With everyone's enthusiastic support and accompaniment, Time-Space Rebuild: The Spiritual Realm Chaos Chapter Full Version officially topped the list of popular new products and the popularity list, and at the same time topped the best-selling list in many regions!
In order to thank you for your support, we have specially prepared a thanksgiving feedback-10 voting tickets, I hope to share this joy with you!

Until 15：00：00 on May 21, 2025 (UTC+8), players who successfully log in to the game and experience it will automatically receive voting tickets.
Tickets will be issued within 10 minutes of the end of the deadline.

Thank you again for your support and love!

notes.title: The Demo Version of Time-Space Rebuild Will Release on April 29 at 13:08 UTC+8!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! The Demo Version of Time-Space Rebuild Will Release on April 29 at 13:08 UTC+8!
Time-Space Rebuild is a sci-fi interactive film game set in an alternate world, centered around relationship  simulation and story-driven adventure. The game is shot in full dynamic live-action with a first-person perspective, aiming to provide players with the most realistic and immersive gaming experience possible.
In this game, you will become a "Raven," a being capable of traversing time and space. As you embark on a journey to save the world, your fate will become intertwined with that of numerous beautiful women, each with unique appearances and personalities. You will step into this silent war, rebuild your identity from fragmented memories, seek glimmers of hope in a shattered timeline, and make countless choices that will shape your destiny.
More details about Time-Space Rebuild will be revealed soon. Join us for the latest updates:
